cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(sinen_vendor C CXX)

# CMake remains the build system of the pinned upstream submodules. Sinen's
# own targets are defined in xmake.lua.
get_filename_component(SINEN_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
option(SINEN_VENDOR_SCRIPT "Build script dependencies" ON)
option(SINEN_VENDOR_GRAPHICS "Build graphics dependencies" ON)
option(SINEN_VENDOR_PHYSICS "Build physics dependencies" ON)
option(SINEN_VENDOR_PROFILER "Build Tracy" ON)
option(SINEN_VENDOR_SLANG "Build Slang" ON)
option(SINEN_VENDOR_TESTS "Build GoogleTest" ON)
option(SINEN_ENABLE_NATIVE_WEBGPU_DAWN "Build with native Dawn" OFF)
if(EMSCRIPTEN)
  add_compile_options(-fPIC "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fexceptions>")
endif()

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
if(ANDROID)
  set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON)
endif()
include("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/libs.cmake")
include("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/licenses.cmake")
sinen_generate_license_header("${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/licenses_data.hpp")

add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/SDL" "libs/SDL" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(SINEN_VENDOR_GRAPHICS)
  set(ASSIMP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(ASSIMP_BUILD_ASSIMP_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_ZLIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  endif()
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/assimp" "libs/assimp" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/msdfgen" "libs/msdfgen" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  set(MESHOPT_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(MESHOPT_BUILD_GLTFPACK OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(MESHOPT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/meshoptimizer" "libs/meshoptimizer" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  foreach(feature DOC JNI PY JS TESTS TOOLS TOOLS_CTS LOADTEST_APPS)
    set(KTX_FEATURE_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  endforeach()
  set(LIBKTX_FEATURE_KTX1 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(LIBKTX_FEATURE_KTX2 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(LIBKTX_FEATURE_VK_UPLOAD ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(LIBKTX_FEATURE_GL_UPLOAD ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ktx-software" "libs/ktx-software" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_PHYSICS)
  foreach(feature SAMPLES BENCHMARKS DOCS UNIT_TESTS)
    set(BOX2D_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BOX3D_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  endforeach()
  set(BOX3D_BUILD_SHADERS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/box2d" "libs/box2d" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/box3d" "libs/box3d" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_SCRIPT)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/luau" "libs/luau" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  set_target_properties(Luau.VM Luau.Ast Luau.Common PROPERTIES
                        POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    target_compile_definitions(Luau.VM PRIVATE "LUA_API=__attribute__((used))")
  endif()
  foreach(target Luau.VM Luau.Compiler)
    get_target_property(defs ${target} INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
    if(defs)
      list(FILTER defs EXCLUDE REGEX [[LUA.*_API]])
      set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${defs}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/cppdap" "libs/cppdap" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/luau-debugger/debugger" "libs/luau-debugger/debugger" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_PROFILER)
  set(TRACY_ENABLE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(TRACY_ON_DEMAND ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(TRACY_ONLY_LOCALHOST ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/tracy" "libs/tracy" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_SLANG AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
  if(ANDROID)
    set(SLANG_EMBED_CORE_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SLANG_EMBED_CORE_MODULE_SOURCE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SLANG_ENABLE_PREBUILT_BINARIES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    foreach(feature CUDA DXIL OPTIX NVAPI GFX SLANGD SLANGC SLANGI
                    SLANG_PROXY SLANGRT SLANG_GLSLANG TESTS EXAMPLES
                    REPLAYER XLIB AFTERMATH)
      set(SLANG_ENABLE_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    endforeach()
    set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANG_RHI OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SLANG_SLANG_LLVM_FLAVOR DISABLE CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    set(SLANG_EXCLUDE_DAWN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SLANG_EXCLUDE_TINT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  endif()
  if(WIN32)
    set(SLANG_EMBED_CORE_MODULE_SOURCE OFF)
    foreach(feature EXAMPLES TESTS REPLAYER SLANGC SLANGD SLANGI GFX)
      set(SLANG_ENABLE_${feature} OFF)
    endforeach()
    set(SLANG_RHI_ENABLE OFF)
    foreach(feature OPTIX CUDA NVAPI CPU D3D11 D3D12 VULKAN WGPU AGILITY_SDK)
      set(SLANG_RHI_ENABLE_${feature} OFF)
    endforeach()
    set(SLANG_LIB_TYPE STATIC)
  endif()
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/shader_compiler/libs/slang"
                   "plugins/shader_compiler/libs/slang" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  if(MSVC AND TARGET libcmark-gfm)
    target_compile_options(libcmark-gfm PUBLIC /utf-8)
  endif()
endif()
if(WIN32 AND SINEN_ENABLE_NATIVE_WEBGPU_DAWN)
  set(WEBGPU_BACKEND DAWN CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
  set(WEBGPU_LINK_TYPE SHARED CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
  set(WEBGPU_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/WebGPU-distribution"
                   "libs/WebGPU-distribution" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_TESTS AND NOT ANDROID)
  add_subdirectory("${SINEN_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/cpp/googletest"
                   "tests/cpp/googletest" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()

set(vendor_targets SDL3::SDL3)
if(SINEN_VENDOR_GRAPHICS)
  list(APPEND vendor_targets assimp meshoptimizer ktx_read msdfgen-core)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_PHYSICS)
  list(APPEND vendor_targets box2d::box2d box3d::box3d)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_SCRIPT)
  list(APPEND vendor_targets Luau.VM Luau.Compiler Luau.Ast Luau.Require
       Luau.Debugger cppdap)
  if(NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    list(APPEND vendor_targets Luau.CodeGen)
  endif()
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_PROFILER)
  list(APPEND vendor_targets Tracy::TracyClient)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_SLANG AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
  list(APPEND vendor_targets slang)
endif()
if(SINEN_VENDOR_TESTS AND NOT ANDROID)
  list(APPEND vendor_targets GTest::gtest_main)
endif()
add_custom_target(sinen_vendor DEPENDS ${vendor_targets})
